synthesis: Scout map zoom-gated features (path/density layers, main-map hit-icon markers) currently only appear once the user zooms in to level 12. The ticket asks to move these 'back by 1 level' — i.e. make them appear one zoom step further out (constant 12 -> 11). The two behaviors named literally (path loading, hit icons) map cleanly to two named constants in ScannerMap.vue; the trailing 'etc' is an unresolved scope question (does it also include the map's default/boot view zoom and/or other zoom-gated detail?).

scope.summary: Single-file frontend constant change in resources/js/clarity-scout/components/ScannerMap.vue: lower the two zoom-floor constants from 12 to 11, then rebuild + commit the tracked Vite assets (public/build). Pending Dalton's answer on 'etc', the map's hardcoded default-view zoom (bootZoom/fallbackZoom = 12) may also move to 11.

'hit icons ... back by 1 level' — gates main-map hit-logo markers (DEV-2016). Comment already notes '11 would match the zone labels'.

questions.q: Beyond the two named gates (path loading + hit icons, both 12->11), what does 'etc' cover? Options: (A) just those two; (B) also the map's default/boot view zoom (bootZoom/fallbackZoom 12->11); (C) also other zoom-gated detail like trail direction arrows (14->13).
questions.answer: A — just the two named gates. Default/boot view zoom and trail arrows are NOT changed.

notes: Pure frontend, ScannerMap.vue constant change; no PHP/migration/CH.
Both constants are shared by the driver PWA and admin Bird's Eye (same component) — the change auto-applies to both; QA should verify both surfaces.

Crash-risk to VERIFY (not a blocker): PATH_LAYERS_MIN_ZOOM's DEV-2185 comment warns a too-wide viewport at 15/30/60 days can crash the browser (scan-path fetch has no server-side row cap). Lowering to 11 roughly quadruples viewport area — QA at the widest (60-day) range.
No JS test runner in this repo (platform is PHPUnit-only) — pinning is manual/agent-browser QA at the map.
public/build is tracked (platform-commits-built-assets) — rebuild + commit assets.

tests.what_it_pins: Manual/agent-browser QA: at zoom 11 in Historical mode with a long date range, path/density layers + hit-icon markers now render (previously hidden until 12); at zoom 10 both still hidden; verify in both driver and Bird's Eye; watch payload/responsiveness at 60-day range zoom 11.
